series_short_description: Pulled barefoot from their tiny studio bed into Vaeloria, Nolan (24) and Gwen (19) journey toward home.
series_description: At twenty-one, verbal autistic retail associate Nolan Lennox (5'7") missed every hidden signal when polite, five-foot-tall Tammy puffed out her chest over a Day-1 lunch at the Emerald Creek Mall food court and told him she was ready for everything—soon finding himself rushed into her un-air-conditioned trailer off Route 13. Two years and two breakups later, when Tammy impulsively drags twenty-three-year-old Nolan to the Norfolk Pathfinder terminal for a surprise Seattle trip without calling forty-eight hours ahead for a wheelchair lift, Nolan breaks up with her for good, rejects her last-ditch sexual enticement in favor of peaceful, yell-free hugs with his neurotypical six-foot-one sister Gwen, and rides CVTA buses home after fellow passengers shield him from Tammy's slap. Grandpa Walter holds on to see Gwen turn eighteen—where an overjoyed Gwen accepts Nolan's invite to live together—before passing away the next morning, leaving Nolan and Gwen to weather probate, sell their childhood home, and share tiny rectangular Studio 2B until an amber rift pulls them barefoot on Lofstrand forearm crutches into twin-moon Vaeloria.
author: Michael Ragsdale
